qualification.education_qualification: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject or PG in a relevant subject, 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent)
qualification.details: Project Technical Support III: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject + three years post-qualification experience OR PG in a relevant subject. Desirable: Post Graduate Degree with research experience in laboratory settings. Job requires hands-on experience in cell culture, molecular biology (RNA isolation, qRT-PCR, western blotting) and animal handling. Project Technical Support I: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) + two years of experience in the relevant subject. Job requires hands-on experience in cell culture, molecular biology (RNA isolation, qRT-PCR, western blotting) and animal handling.

salary_details.details: Project Technical Support III: Rs. 28,000/- per month plus 30% HRA Project Technical Support I: Rs. 18,000/- per month plus 30% HRA

Read the official notification carefully before applying.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NII Recruitment 2026 is 21st September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Support-III and Project Technical Support-I positions in the National Institute of Immunology (NII) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NII Recruitment 2026 is through email. Candidates are required to send their complete application along with necessary documents via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III position is Rs. 28,000/- per month plus 30% HRA. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-I, candidates need to have completed 10th grade followed by a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) and possess at least two years of experience in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General and OBC category candidates need to pay Rs. 100/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NII Recruitment 2026 involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Technical Support-III and Project Technical Support-I at the National Institute of Immunology are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Institute of Immunology located?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Immunology (NII) is located in New Delhi, Delhi. This recruitment is for candidates looking for government jobs in the capital city.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-III, candidates need to have three years of post-qualification experience in a relevant subject after completing a three-year graduate degree, or a PG degree in a relevant subject.
